svg.title: XLang3 long dictionary diagnostic, accepted A equals one
svg.desc: Speed is the median of three within-cycle accepted A time divided by runtime time ratios. A is 1.000x, E is 0.896x, F is 0.988x. This is an unscored XLang3 build comparison with 189 retained samples, not a CPython or pyperformance suite score.

g.text: Median within-cycle A time / runtime time · higher is faster · diagnostic only
3 rotated cycles · 21 samples/build/cycle · 189 raw timings · async score incomplete; diagnostic only
